display_title: MA206 Probability & Statistics: Course Guide and Interactive Inference Apps
one_liner: Full-semester USMA intro stats course: a Quarto course guide, R/Colab lesson notebooks, and a 10-page Streamlit app for hypothesis tests and confidence intervals.
problem: Non-major cadets have to learn to reason from data, not just memorize formulas.
approach: Six-step statistical investigation method; worked examples on public and synthetic military datasets; interactive apps (CI coverage animation, Wald/Wilson/Agresti-Coull/Clopper-Pearson comparison, z/t/Welch/paired walkthroughs).
decision_relevance: Shows the ability to make inference and uncertainty understandable to non-specialist decision makers, a core ORSA briefing skill.

headline_results.claim: Interactive CI coverage explorer and four-method proportion CI comparison
